entries.zh: 还：偿还（欠款）；归还；还情（报答人情）
entries.en: to pay back; to give back what is owed; to return a favor

entries.zh: 销：注销；销去；交还先前所给之物（清账了结）
entries.en: to cancel, to wipe out; to give back what was given at first
entries.notes: 西语词头讹损（lo que en comen daron 无法确读），据汉字'銷'（注销/销账）与还物语境推断

entries.zh: 销票：注销票帖/传票，退回签发之人
entries.en: to cancel a warrant (boleta) and return it to the one who issued it

entries.zh: 销×：退还所领票帖（次字原稿存疑：拴/挲）
entries.en: to return the warrant to the one who issued it (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:拴/挲]且音写 pèy 与两候选字皆不吻合，释义依西语'退还 mandamiento'推断

entries.zh: 到（通'倒'）：倒转；翻转过来
entries.en: to turn over; to turn to the reverse side
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏[残]（T99），西语词头后半亦讹，据'到'=倒与 volver al revés 推断

entries.zh: 到船：船返回；船抵返（调转船头）
entries.en: (of a ship) to come back; for the boat to return / put about

entries.zh: 到头：回头；转过头来
entries.en: to turn the head back; to turn one's head around

entries.zh: 到（倒）去：回去；返回原处
entries.en: to go back; to return to where one came from

entries.zh: 到来：来；到来（返回至此）
entries.en: to come; to arrive; to come back

entries.zh: 到屏：逐退；屏退（词义难以坐实，存疑）
entries.en: possibly 'to repel, to dismiss' (屏 bǐng, to expel); sense unresolved
entries.notes: 西语词头讹乱（Boluer aluemi, darclon cado rado 无法复原），汉字'到屏'组合义不明

entries.zh: 到（倒）连转：来回打转；翻来覆去
entries.en: to turn round and round; to spin over and over
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:蓮/連]，依西语'dando le una y otra buelta'（来回翻转）释义

entries.zh: 到（倒）行：倒退而行；转身往回走
entries.en: to walk backwards; to turn and go back the way one came

entries.zh: 到（倒）流：（水）倒流；回流
entries.en: (of water) to flow backwards; to flow in reverse
entries.notes: 官话对音栏[残]（tôn [残] hì），据汉字'到流'=倒流与闽音 laū 推断

entries.zh: 到做：重新做；再做一遍
entries.en: to do it again; to redo
entries.notes: 'Boluer lo a ha cer'当为 volverlo a hacer；'到做'非汉语常语，据西语释义推断

entries.zh: 翻：翻转；翻过另一面
entries.en: to turn over; to flip to the other side

entries.zh: 翻转头：掉转头来；转头
entries.en: to turn the head around; to turn one's head back
entries.notes: 西语词头含[残]，据汉字'翻轉頭'与音写推断

entries.zh: 翻转身：转身；翻身（如舞蹈中转身）
entries.en: to turn one's whole body around; to spin round (as in a dance)

entries.zh: 翻×转：头来回转动（中字原稿存疑：蓮/薛）
entries.en: to turn the head from one side to the other; to shake the head about
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:蓮/薛]，官话对音 liên 与'連'相合，依西语'头左右转动'释义

entries.zh: 翻转来：翻转身回来；转身回望
entries.en: to turn back and return; to look back while turning round

entries.zh: 回：归还；偿付欠债
entries.en: to give back; to repay a debt
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅单字'回'而闽南音写含三音节（Hūe līn chūy），与西语'还债'义的对应依赖推断

entries.zh: 回来：回来；返回
entries.en: to come back; to return

entries.zh: 回归：回归；返回原处
entries.en: to return; to go back to where one belongs

entries.zh: 反：反悔；翻悔（背弃已言定之事）
entries.en: to go back on one's word; to renege on what was agreed
entries.notes: 西语词头有讹字（quaia≈haya），据'volverse de lo que haya dicho determinado'推断为反悔
